resolved_findings.finding: Deferred selection and subscription helpers could request a TrackPlan lock after the User/track lock.
resolved_findings.resolution: Preserve the existing Customer and Plan checks before User/track. Retained reads use exact row capabilities and typed binding inside the User/track lock.

resolved_findings.finding: A permitted nonworker Customer subscription update could change retained validity outside the User/track lock.
resolved_findings.resolution: The Customer subscription UPDATE binding now takes the same User/track transaction lock. The worker subscription UPDATE pattern remains disallowed.

resolved_findings.finding: The durable Track receipt had a format check for its fingerprint. The command and effect fingerprints were bound separately to the outbox payload.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both positive receipt branches now compare the Track receipt fingerprint to the same canonical outbox payload hash.
